# OblivionUI 0.3.2 — installable mod

Copy this complete OblivionUI directory into your OBMP server mods directory alongside OblivionMP.SDK >= 0.2.0. Reconnect/restart clients to receive the updated mod. Keep both DLLs and all three asset containers in client together. No Unreal installation is needed to install this prebuilt package.

Alt+B opens the demonstration book. Alt+N previews notifications. The full source repository README documents Hud.SetPrompt, Notifications.Show and Books.Open, with compilable examples.

Targets Unreal Engine 5.3.2 and a compatible OBMP client. Font credit: Kingthings Petrock by Kevin King; see kingthingsEULA.txt.
